judge.rationale: The finding explicitly states that formatPrice fully duplicates formatMoney from src/money.ts, enumerating the overlapping logic (currency symbol map, negative/sign handling, cent splitting, thousands grouping, output format) and even backing it with an 85-case output comparison. It names the existing primitive (formatMoney / src/money.ts) as the reuse target, and the remedy is aligned: delete src/pricing.ts and use formatMoney, or re-export formatMoney from src/money.ts if a pricing entry point is needed — no second implementation is kept. The location is cited as src/pricing.ts:1, satisfying the line-number requirement.
